task.title: Sign Your Commits
task.shortdesc: Sign commits with an SSH or GPG key when your environment is set up for it.

context.p: If your environment is configured for commit signing, the Git Client signs your commits with SSH or GPG keys. You do not need to do anything extra when you commit.

step.cmd: Configure GPG signing through the GNUPGHOME environment variable.

info.p: GPG support honors GNUPGHOME as the directory where your keys are stored. If it is not set, the Git Client uses %APPDATA%\gnupg on Windows and ~/.gnupg on other systems. The jgit.gpg.home Java system property takes precedence over GNUPGHOME if both are set.
